test_title: PYST 23: SSC CHSL - Reasoning (Held On: 6 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the figure that will replace the question mark (?) in the following figure series. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bf680590689dabdf05c0c19e20d991995f6f49033b2d03974c42f8b3ace46e6b.png]
solution:
The figure that will replace the question mark (?) in the given figure series is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a3c1e5bf73cfc5848cfd7b4a9ddc79453bd10ccb9b098a8d9c664b5bdb56ac4c.png] 

The pattern followed in the first figure is common in every figure and is: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f1264361bcbdc06577e61a80835a38d383fea5bd682e7cc82856c447a0bbb06b.png] 

 
• The center piece moves to top left corner.
 
• The top left corner piece moves to top right corner.
 
• The top right corner piece moves to bottom left corner.
 
• The bottom left corner piece moves to bottom right corner.
 
• And, the bottom right corner piece moves to the center.

Hence,** option 2)** is the correct answer.
